source: existing OSM source footprints and approximate DSM; model-only surroundings
scope: 100–350m back-row entries and foundations;1.4m apron coverage expanded from135 to680visual profiles
entryHeightPolicy: Highest physical terrain under full door-width narrow strip;25cm decorative threshold tolerance. Steeper or headroom-blocked default doors are suppressed; no invented stairs. Final pad terrain is reconciled at runtime.
foundationPolicy: Existing source-ring-only gap closure up to2m; no grading or footprint growth. Physical prism accompanies every visible skirt.
apronPolicy: Existing1.4m model paving band, single surface partition on physical terrain; road/shore/sand/prior mapped surfaces retain their owners. Not surveyed paving extent.
